content: 百利天恒：宜泽康®联合放疗治疗头颈鳞癌获临床试验批准 百利天恒688506.SH)公告称，公司近日收到国家药监局批准签发的《药物临床试验批准通知书》，公司自主研发的全球首创双抗ADC药物宜泽康®(伦康依隆妥单抗)联合放疗局部晚期不可切除头颈鳞癌及其他实体瘤的临床试验获批准。

title: I just want to pay my respect and thanks to Karoline Leavitt for the fantastic job she has done as White House Press Secretary — Could not have been better! President DONALD J. TRUMP
content: I just want to pay my respect and thanks to Karoline Leavitt for the fantastic job she has done as White House Press Secretary — Could not have been better! President DONALD J. TRUMP

title: I am pleased to announce that Katie Zacharia will be beginning her term as Press Secretary tomorrow, Columbus Day, and will be doing an introductory News Conference on Tuesday at 9:30 A.M. from the Press Briefing Room in the White House. Katie has been with me, in spirit, from the very beginning, and will do a fantastic job! President DONALD J. TRUMP

title: My Rallies, legendary they have already become, have made a tremendous difference with the enthusiasm of the Republican Party. They have been waiting for them to happen, even though I never thought I’d have to be doing Rallies again. The good news is, I love them, the music, and the incredible enthusiasm, and will always be in favor of what’s good for America — and that means the Republican Party. Next stop, tomorrow, Youngstown, Ohio, for our Great Senator Jon Husted, and my friend, Vivek Ramaswamy for Governor, where the Crowds are already waiting in line — and then Alaska, for the Re-Election of one of the Greatest Senators in America, Dan S. Sullivan, and Congressman Nick Begich, who has a Big Future in Alaska. See you there! President DONALD J. TRUMP
